The '''Twin SP.9''' was a self-propelled variant of the [[Twin DF.9/Legends|Twin DF.9]] anti-[[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] battery produced by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]]. They shared the Twin DF.9's feature of faster firing [[DF.9 laser cannon]]s, but with a reduced blast radius.<ref name="RASB2" />
